findings.text: follow-on: the commit deletes the crew decode memo's own bound and per-sweep release, so the only ceiling on the per-run document memo is file_memo._MAX_ENTRIES, which no test exercises; removing or raising the eviction loop would leave a long-lived producer unbounded and nothing would redden.

follow-on: release_unopened_documents is removed, so a run file deleted or renamed between sweeps now keeps its parse until LRU eviction (up to 50,000 entries) rather than being dropped at the next sweep, a retention change the fragment discloses but no test pins.

item_verdicts.diff: read the single gained commit 71d8a9b292bb against dc586bfe9; it deletes the forked _DOCUMENT_CACHE, document_identity and release_unopened_documents from reckon/ledger.py and the _held_worktree_duties split from reckon/crew/obligations.py, routes read_document (:1095) and _aggregate_rows (:471) through reckon/file_memo.py, and replaces two durability tests with one deep-copy-isolation test.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_sweep_decodes_each_document_once.py over a fixture of 200 per-run files and 20 live pointers counting json.loads per sweep; logs/head-gate.log records "69 passed in 206.55s" EXIT=0 at 71d8a9b292bb and negative-control/base-tree-count.log records the base arm "3 failed, 1 passed in 21.27s" EXIT=1 with test_one_sweep_decodes_each_document_once failing, but the done_when's ruff arm is recorded by no log and by no manifest line.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is one obligation sweep decoding each crew document at most once and a later sweep skipping a stat-unchanged document; this gained commit is a refactor of that landed work, at reckon/ledger.py:1095 read_document delegates to reckon/file_memo.py:43 memoized, so the behaviour is preserved and only its ownership moves.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names the six commits, the head arm "69 passed" EXIT=0 at 71d8a9b292bb, the base arm "3 failed 1 passed" EXIT=1, and discloses under follow_ons that live-pointer documents, mounts.json and ledger index payloads remain multi-decoded outside the fence.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/obligations.py, reckon/ledger.py, reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py, tests/test_a_sweep_decodes_each_document_once.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; git diff dc586bfe928a1dc8a4dd9a30d135ddb47e44a3d4..71d8a9b292bb57d97a4fbb024af73f7252d2d8b4 touches only ledger.py, obligations.py, the test file and the fragment, all inside the declared set, with recovery_classification.py and the figures path declared but untouched.

justifications.durability: the added assertion at tests/test_a_sweep_decodes_each_document_once.py:210 reddens if read_document stops returning an isolated record (the base arm shows it failing), but the commit also removed test_a_sweep_drops_the_documents_it_did_not_open and test_the_memo_stays_within_its_bound_across_changing_files, so the bound and per-sweep-release guarantees on this path now rest on reckon/file_memo.py:21, which no test exercises.
justifications.evidence: the pytest gate and its base negative control are recorded in logs/head-gate.log and negative-control/base-tree-count.log, but the done_when's ruff arm is named by no log and by no manifest line, so one of the declared arms is claimed rather than measured.
justifications.fit: reckon/ledger.py:1092 names the memo kind by mechanism and the added comment at :1085 follows the module's stated-rationale idiom, and no name or comment carries a plan, ticket or release label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:1095 keeps the per-run decode memoised through reckon/file_memo.py:43 and the second-sweep skip is still proven at tests/test_a_sweep_decodes_each_document_once.py:184, but the goal's "each crew document" remains unmet for live pointers, mounts.json and the ledger index, which the manifest's own follow_ons names.
justifications.reuse: reckon/ledger.py:1097 and reckon/crew/obligations.py:471 route the crew decode and row identity through the owner reckon/file_memo.py:43 memoized / :30 file_signature, removing the fork the previous revision carried rather than adding a second memo.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff dc586bfe928a1dc8a4dd9a30d135ddb47e44a3d4..71d8a9b292bb57d97a4fbb024af73f7252d2d8b4 (reckon/ledger.py, reckon/crew/obligations.py, tests/test_a_sweep_decodes_each_document_once.py, the fragment) is inside the write paths the manifest declares.
